@@ -236,3 +236,23 @@
-        prev = idx
-        app((chr(p0) + chr(p1), chr(idx)))
-    return table
+        prev = idx
+        a = chr(p0)
+        b = chr(p1)
+        app((a + b, chr(idx), a, b))
+    return table
+
+
+def _apply_table(s, table):
+    """
+    Apply every replacement of a _replace_table to s, in order. A merge can
+    only match when both of its tokens occur in s, so `present` (a superset of
+    the code points currently in s: tokens are added when minted, never
+    removed) lets most absent merges skip the full str.replace scan.
+    """
+    present = set(s)
+    add = present.add
+    for ps, c, a, b in table:
+        if a in present and b in present:
+            n = len(s)
+            s = s.replace(ps, c)
+            if len(s) != n:
+                add(c)
+    return s
